olist_orders_dataset.description: Main fact table containing one row per order. Central table for order analytics, delivery performance, fulfillment tracking, customer activity analysis, and sales trend reporting.

olist_order_items_dataset.description: Contains line-item level order information. Primary table for revenue analysis, product sales analysis, seller performance, and freight cost calculations.

olist_order_payments_dataset.description: Payment transaction details for orders. Used for revenue calculations, payment type analysis, installment behavior studies, and transaction value reporting.

olist_order_reviews_dataset.description: Customer review and rating information. Used for customer satisfaction tracking, sentiment analysis, and product or seller quality evaluation.

olist_customers_dataset.description: Customer profile and location data. Used for geographic sales analysis, customer segmentation, regional demand analysis, and repeat customer studies.

olist_sellers_dataset.description: Seller profile and location data. Used for seller ranking, revenue attribution, marketplace performance monitoring, and geographic seller analysis.

olist_products_dataset.description: Product catalog information including category and physical attributes. Used for category performance analysis, product popularity tracking, and logistics-related studies.

olist_geolocation_dataset.description: Brazilian zip code to geographic coordinate mapping. Used for geospatial analysis, regional delivery studies, and customer or seller location visualization.

product_category_name_translation.description: Translation table mapping Portuguese product categories to English names. Used for readable reporting, dashboards, and category-based analytics.
